name: @motivity/frs
description: Motivity Face Recognition System — repo root. This file has no dependencies of its own and is not an npm workspace: frontend/, backend/api/, and backend/api-retail/ are independent services, each with its own package.json, package-lock.json, and node_modules. Run `npm install` inside each one separately. The scripts below are just thin convenience wrappers (via --prefix) for running them from the repo root.

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix backend/api install && npm --prefix backend/api-retail install
